class.name: EngineSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the frame rate limit, time scale, physics rate, audio speed and low-processor mode.

method.name: get_audio_playback_speed_scale
method.description: Returns the pending audio playback speed. See [member EngineSettings.audio_playback_speed_scale].

method.name: get_low_processor_mode_sleep_usec
method.description: Returns the pending sleep time between frames in low-processor mode, in microseconds.

method.name: get_max_fps
method.description: Returns the pending frame rate limit; [code]0[/code] means unlimited. A [code]--max-fps[/code] session override is not included; see [method SettingsServer.has_session_override].

method.name: get_max_physics_steps_per_frame
method.description: Returns the pending maximum number of physics steps per rendered frame.

method.name: get_physics_jitter_fix
method.description: Returns the pending physics jitter fix threshold.

method.name: get_physics_ticks_per_second
method.description: Returns the pending physics rate in ticks per second.

method.name: get_simulation_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the simulation values: [code]time_scale[/code], [code]physics_ticks_per_second[/code], [code]max_physics_steps_per_frame[/code], [code]physics_jitter_fix[/code] and [code]audio_playback_speed_scale[/code].

method.name: get_time_scale
method.description: Returns the pending time scale. A [code]--time-scale[/code] session override is not included.

method.name: is_low_processor_mode_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the low-processor mode is enabled in the pending settings.

method.name: is_physics_interpolation_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if physics interpolation is enabled in the pending settings.

method.name: is_simulation_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the simulation values stay at the project values, that is, if [member ProjectSettings.settings/engine/allow_simulation_values] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_simulation_setting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param name] is one of the simulation values (see [method get_simulation_setting_names]).

method.name: set_audio_playback_speed_scale
method.description: Sets the playback speed of all audio, clamped to [code]0.01[/code]–[code]4.0[/code]. Ignored with a warning while [method is_simulation_locked] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_low_processor_mode_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables the low-processor mode (a battery saver): the engine only redraws when something changes.

method.name: set_low_processor_mode_sleep_usec
method.description: Sets the sleep time between frames in low-processor mode, in microseconds, clamped to [code]0[/code]–[code]1000000[/code].

method.name: set_max_fps
method.description: Sets the frame rate limit; [code]0[/code] means unlimited. Negative values become [code]0[/code]. Replaces a [code]--max-fps[/code] session override.

method.name: set_max_physics_steps_per_frame
method.description: Sets the maximum number of physics steps per rendered frame, clamped to [code]1[/code]–[code]100[/code]. Ignored with a warning while [method is_simulation_locked] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_physics_interpolation_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables physics interpolation of the [SceneTree].

method.name: set_physics_jitter_fix
method.description: Sets the physics jitter fix threshold, clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]2.0[/code]. Ignored with a warning while [method is_simulation_locked] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_physics_ticks_per_second
method.description: Sets the physics rate, clamped to [code]1[/code]–[code]1000[/code]. Ignored with a warning while [method is_simulation_locked] is [code]true[/code]. Changing the physics rate changes how the game behaves; consider enabling physics interpolation for rates that are not a multiple of the display refresh rate.

method.name: set_time_scale
method.description: Sets the game speed, clamped to [code]0.01[/code]–[code]100.0[/code]. Ignored with a warning while [method is_simulation_locked] is [code]true[/code]. Replaces a [code]--time-scale[/code] session override.
